environment.description: Quarkus Lambda function deployed in VPC (subnet-0a1b2c3d, subnet-0e4f5a6b) with API Gateway configured as PRIVATE type. Access governed by resource policy restricting invoke to vpce-0abc123def456789a. The VPC endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0fedcba987654321) is configured with a security group (sg-0x9y8z7w6v) allowing inbound TCP/443 only from CIDR 10.42.16.0/28 (internal monitoring subnet). The endpoint has private DNS disabled and requires explicit endpoint URL usage. Lambda ENIs attached to sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f which has no inbound rules and outbound only to the Secrets Manager VPC endpoint (vpce-0sm123456789) on port 443. No NAT gateway or internet gateway in the VPC route tables for the Lambda subnets.

config.lambda_security_group: sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f: no inbound, outbound TCP/443 to pl-secretsmanager only
config.vpc_route_tables: local routes only, no igw, no nat
config.lambda_subnets: private isolated subnets, no internet path
